items.title: How AI spending limits could help hyperscaler bonds but hurt stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- A regulatory brake on AI data-center spending could be good for hyperscaler bonds and bad for their stocks. The two groups want different things from the same company.

items.title: Ezra Klein Floats “the End of Oracle” as OpenAI Weighs Smaller Data Center Plans
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAfter this week’s elections, OpenAI’s senior leaders discussed whether to reset next year’s data center capacity plans, the Wall Street Journal reported, and Ezra Klein raised “the end of Oracle” on the Hard Fork podcast. Klein’s line is hyperbole, but Oracle is the big company most exposed to a smaller OpenAI build, since S&P says OpenAI accounts for about half of its $664 billion backlog.

items.title: Bloom Energy Rises 2%, AMD Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound From Midterm Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 2% today as AI stocks, AMD among them, bounced back from Thursday’s post-midterm selloff. Bloom had just landed a 900-megawatt NTT DATA deal and a 1-gigawatt plan with California Resources.

items.title: Oracle falls 4% as Microsoft reportedly winds down AI cloud capacity deal
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oracle shares fell 4% Friday after Bloomberg reported that Microsoft is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing capacity from the company, adding to investor concerns about the sustainability of AI infrastructure spending following Thursday’s sharp selloff in AI-related stocks.

items.title: Microsoft Is Winding Down Oracle Deal to Rent AI Cloud Capacity
items.summary: Microsoft Corp. is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing from Oracle Corp., part of a larger reassessment of billions of dollars in cloud partnerships.
